notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that has morph or megamorph.
You have a creature card in hand that has morph or megamorph.
description:
Cast the creature card in your hand for its morph or megamorph cost by paying {0}, putting it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another creature card with morph or megamorph from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
